page.layout: One printed page, title page, centred lines; an engraving (angel with trumpets above a globe, two figures with instruments) below the title lines; imprint below the engraving. No margins with text.
page.notes: An engraving stands between the title and the imprint: an winged figure with trumpets balanced on a globe (armillary sphere), flanked by two figures with a spade and with a measuring instrument. The line "CORPORIS THEOLOGIÆ" is set in italic capitals; "TIGURI." and "Typis HENRICI BODMERI." are in italic/mixed type; the date line is in Roman capitals with the old form MDCXCVI, read here as printed.
